name: Microwave oven production line solution
summary: A complete line automation solution for microwave oven manufacturers, covering cavity assembly, door installation, electrical wiring, and final inspection and packaging.
contentHtml:
The microwave oven production line solution is a complete line automation solution provided by TXAM for microwave oven manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The entire line covers the full process including cavity forming, magnetron installation, waveguide installation, door installation, electrical wiring, panel installation, performance testing, and automatic packaging.

Technical Advantages

  • Automated cavity forming with high dimensional accuracy
  • Precise magnetron installation ensuring microwave performance
  • Automated door installation for consistent sealing effect
  • Standardized electrical wiring with high connection reliability
  • Fast multi-model switching for high capacity utilization
  • High level of line automation for high production efficiency

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.
